svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Turn as the top plug: flange 63 mm x 4 mm, spigot 57 mm x 18 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two O-ring grooves 2.5 x 1.8 mm, 10 and 15 mm above the flange.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Centre hole: drill 14.5 mm and tap M16 x 1.5 right through, for

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the front-mount M12 panel socket (check its thread first).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Face the outside of the flange flat where the socket's O-ring sits.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Radial holes: drill 3.3 mm, tap M4, through the tube's holes,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4 mm above the flange, 120 degrees apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the socket screws in from outside with its O-ring under its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flange; its lock nut and the board lead are inside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the socket seats flat; the plug pushes in by hand.
